gloss: moving work; touching film or book

definitions.gloss: moving work; touching film or book
definitions.explanation: A film, novel, or other creative work that deeply moves its audience. Frequently used in advertising and reviews.

examples.japanese: これは{今年|ことし}{一番|いちばん}の{感動作|かんどうさく}だ。
examples.english: This is the most moving work of the year.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}なしには{見|み}られない{感動作|かんどうさく}だった。
examples.english: It was a moving work you couldn't watch without tears.

examples.japanese: この{監督|かんとく}は{家族|かぞく}をテーマにした{感動作|かんどうさく}で{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This director is known for moving works on the theme of family.

notes:
Compound of {感動|かんどう} (being moved, deep emotion) + {作|さく} (a work). Often used in promotional copy, as in {感動|かんどう}の{超大作|ちょうたいさく} (a moving blockbuster).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話題|わだい}の{感動作|かんどうさく}: a talked-about moving work
- {感動作|かんどうさく}を{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to create a moving work
- {不朽|ふきゅう}の{感動作|かんどうさく}: an immortal moving work
